messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly check on Brightlane — noticed a morning spike in 5xx and client timeouts around 09:12-09:40 UTC. Overall spend steady but latency up.
noah_sre: Thanks, pulling traces now. Any account-specific rate limit changes? @lee_ae
lee_ae: No config changes on our side. Renewal meeting next Tues, want to keep this calm.
maria_cs: top failing routes from dashboard:
```
POST /v1/generate (5xx 2.9%)
POST /v1/chat/stream (timeout 1.7%)
POST /v1/embeddings (rate_limit 0.8%)
GET  /v1/health/check (5xx 0.6%)
```
noah_sre: seeing a correlated increase in queue length on the dedicated pool, specifically worker-gpu-7. Attaching snippet of logs:
```
2028-06-12T09:14:03Z worker-gpu-7 ERROR kv-cache-timeout
2028-06-12T09:14:05Z worker-gpu-7 502 backend: out-of-memory
```
sam_engineer: sounds like a transient memory pressure — recent rollout of batcher v2? Anyone rolled forward?
noah_sre: @sam_engineer yes, rollout started 2 days ago. Canary looked fine but peak QPS was higher today.
sam_engineer: reverting canary to v1 on gpu-7 now, will monitor. :gear:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20280612-0930 — Brightlane 5xx/timeouts spike (assigned: noah_sre)
maria_cs: Thanks. Action items: 1) Sam revert tracked, 2) Noah to confirm if fallback routing triggered to cheaper pool, 3) I'll message Brightlane with a brief note letting them know we're on it. Any ETA on stabilization?
noah_sre: expecting reduced errors within 15-20m after revert. Will post update here.
maria_cs: Perfect — I'll pause renewal outreach until we confirm stable. :thumbsup: 
noah_sre: update: errors down to baseline at 09:32 UTC. queue length normalized. Closing INC-20280612-0930 after postmortem scheduled tomorrow.
maria_cs: Great, please ping once the postmortem has a short summary I can forward to Brightlane. Thanks team!
